summary: A realtime 1v1 on Quicksilver in the user's lobby, the second game with people: our Cortex seat against an Armada person. Our opening never made a soldier. The hands' default text put the lab up at 0:12, before any generator and before the player's first packet landed. The lab then took three constructor picks in 13 s, and the energy store sat empty from 0:51 (e0% 45.7) while the metal bank held 500-600; the player slept through all of it on a 90 s wait. The person's Pawns arrived at 2:04 and numbered nine by 3:21. Against zero soldiers, and with no attack for the commander on the hands' menu (the player ordered one in five packets), they took both extractors, the windmills, the lab (2:35) and every constructor by 3:07. The commander was walked east at 3:10, killed six Pawns in 11 s while chased and died at 3:40. The opponent's verdict at 3:05 was "you will need something like 20 e for every m. Making more than 1 or two construction bots will make defending yourself hard"; most of the harness faults behind the loss were fixed that night (36cbfd7, 0e6f54f, b31c9ed).

root.what: The opening put a lab before any generator and three constructors before any soldier. The hands' default text built the lab at 0:12 (Jev pick 0.46, before the player's first packet landed), and the first generator came at 0:45. The lab took three constructor picks in 13 s and built them back to back with the store empty. The player's own packet asked for 'a couple of constructors first' and slept 90 s. The cause (energy per metal, too many constructors) is the person's, 3:05; the harness part is the reader's reading.

their_play: Armada Pawn rush (armpw). The first Pawn was seen at 2:04 at E4, a party at (4192, 3036) south of our base. There were two at 2:10, five by 2:40, seven or eight by 3:00 and nine by 3:21. They went for the naked extractors and windmills first (spot_14 2:12, spot_12 2:20, spot_20 2:30), then the lab (2:35) and the constructors (2:44, 3:07). They chased the commander east and lost six Pawns (324 metal) to it at 3:26-3:37 while taking it from 100% to 0. None of his buildings was seen and his start was never scouted. He typed advice at 3:05 and corrected our player's wind claim at 3:39.

bears_on.note: This game is the source of the block's line "you will need something like 20 e for every m. Making more than 1 or two construction bots will make defending yourself hard" (3:05, the opponent) and its context: three constructors queued, the store at zero, the lab dead at 2:35. The block dates the games 2026-09-19 and 20; this one ran 2026-09-21.
The energy is there so the first constructor builds at full speed. Here there was no generator before the lab, and the first constructor took 47 s (0:37-1:24) with the store at zero.
The commander never assisted the lab (assist4 0); it walked to windmills and extractors, and by 2:29-2:39 was building windmills 337-359 from spot_20 while the lab died.

Only the closing clause applies: 'too many construction bots, made and kept out on the map'. Three of the lab's three units were constructors (fac4 2 finished), and a constructor was sent out alone to 'enemy_base'.
Seen from the person's side: his first handful of Pawns crossed by 2:04 and ended a greedy constructor opening by 3:07, against zero soldiers.

tools: record-0.jsonl read directly (events, Jev decisions, samples)
lens.caveats: No truth file, so the opponent is only what we saw. pro_baseline.py was not run: Quicksilver has no cards. minutes.py and analyze_match read the intent's wrong enemy start (spot_8, 581 from home) and call both starts E3, so their 'his half' columns are wrong. raid_ledger counts our two abandoned frames (spot_14 1:36, spot_8 2:45) as losses to 'def-1'; analyze has 5 extractors killed by Pawns. chat.jsonl gives speaker '?' for all three lines; bot.log gives 3:05 and 3:39 to player 1 (the person) and 3:09 to player 2 (our player). The ledger row for this directory is labelled human-2. The record's unit-def ids are list indexes (302 corcom, 395 corlab, 301 corck, 404 cormex, 505 corwin, 181 armpw).

open_questions: Who was the opponent and what is his rating? The header recorded no one; is he human-1's opponent or its advisor?

Would the commander, given an attack at 2:10, have held the first two Pawns while the lab finished? It killed six in 11 s at 3:26-3:37 while walking away, which suggests yes; unmeasured.
Which fix ended the commander abandoning a fresh extractor frame for a windmill (1:27-1:36)? Not traced.
